_comment: A fictional project's values, in the shape the skill writes and render-template.mjs reads. The guard test renders the loop with these flags, with every flag on and with every flag off.

values.DECISIONS: `docs/decisions/*.md` (ADRs) and the memory directory. Where these contradict `docs/`, the decisions win.
values.GATE_CHECKS:
- api: `npm test && npm run lint && npm run build`
- web: `npm test && npm run e2e && npm run lint && npm run build`
values.AUDIT_COMMAND: `npm audit --omit=dev` shows no high or critical vulnerabilities in either app.
values.REAL_SYSTEM: the browser via Playwright, and the deployed site
values.SHARD_REFRESH_RECIPE: a test without a time logs `no recorded duration for …`; download the run's blob reports and run `node scripts/shard-plan.mjs --record`.
values.BROWSER_MATRIX: desktop Chrome and a 390×844 touch phone
values.PRODUCTION_LOG_CHECK: the service's containers are healthy, with no errors in their logs since the deploy (read-only check)
values.HUMAN_ONLY_ITEMS: - checks on the payment provider's live dashboard;
values.PREAUTHORISED: - Set the repo's GitHub secrets with `gh secret set`, reading each value from its source.
values.SECRETS_POLICY: - `STRIPE_TEST_KEY`: from the password manager's CLI, piped to `gh secret set`.
values.TEST_ACCOUNTS: One live-test account, credentials in the gitignored `.env.e2e` and the `E2E_PASSWORD` secret.
values.FORBIDDEN_EXTRA: - switching the payment provider out of test mode;
values.MACHINE_QUIRKS: - Docker runs in a VM with 4 GB: run one compose stack at a time.
values.PREFLIGHT_GAPS: - The GitHub token lacks `write:packages`; publishing phases get a human-queue item.
